missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'База' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'находится'. 'Наша' is the agreeing feminine possessive, and 'далеко' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Базу' is the accusative direct object of 'строим', with the ending shifting from -а to -у. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Базы' is the genitive required after 'около' to mean near the base. 'Машины' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят'.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Базу' is accusative after 'на' showing motion toward the base. 'Солдаты' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На базе' uses the prepositional form 'базе' after 'на' to express location. 'Военной' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Базой' is the instrumental case required by the verb 'управляет', which governs the instrumental. 'Всей' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Базе' is the dative required after 'к' to show movement toward the base. 'Пешком' specifies the manner of travel.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Базы' is the accusative plural object of 'построили'. 'Новые' agrees in the plural, and 'в горах' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О базе' uses the prepositional form 'базе' after 'об' to talk about the base. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative question. 'База' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'находится'. 'Ближайшая' is the agreeing feminine superlative adjective in this question with 'где'.
